_notes: Xhosa translations verified against UCT Xhosa Health Vocabulary, SAHO oral health glossary, and community usage cross-referencing.

today.desc_menstrual: Umzimba wakho uyakhulula. Ukuphumla, ubushushu, nokunyakaza kancinci kukuxhasa kakuhle ngoku.
today.desc_follicular: Amandla ayakhula. Ulusu lwakho lukhanya kakhulu, ingqondo yakho ibukhali. Ixesha elihle lokuhlela nokudala.
today.desc_ovulation: Usemazingeni aphezulu. Ukuzithemba kuphezulu, ulusu lukhanya, nokuqhagamshelana kufika ngokwemvelo.
today.desc_luteal: Ukuhamba kancinci bubulumko. Umzimba wakho ulungiselela. Hloniphe oko okufunekayo uziphathele kakuhle.
today.desc_unknown: Rekhoda ixesha lakho lokugqibela ukuvula ulwazi lomjikelo wakho.
today.cta_follicular: Ulusu lwakho lukhanya kakhulu eli veki. Ixesha elihle lokubhuka ukususwa koboya okanye unyango lobuso.
today.cta_ovulation: Ulusu lwakho lukhanya ngoku. Sebenzisa ngokupheleleyo ngokunyanzelisa unyango.
today.countdown_days: Ixesha lakho elilandelayo lifikile kwimihla engu-{count}
today.countdown_day: Ixesha lakho elilandelayo lifikile kwimini engu-{count}

log.title: tara-s
log.body: Ubehlala azi umzimba wakhe. Le ndawo ingeyakho ukukhumbula.

insights.title: Oko umzimba wakho ukutshoyo.
insights.subtitle: Iimowudi ezivela kwinto oyirekhodeyo.
insights.empty_title: Iindlela zakho ziya kubonakala apha njengoko urekhoda.
insights.need_more_data_body: Rekhoda omnye umjikelo kwaye TARA-S iqale ukubona iindlela zakho.
insights.avg_duration: Ixesha lakho lihlala lide imihla engu-{days}.
insights.variability_consistent: Imijikelo yakho ibifanana kakhulu kutsha nje.
insights.variability_regular: Imijikelo yakho ilandela umculo omhle. Umahluko omncinci uwayamkelekile ncam.
insights.variability_irregular: Imijikelo yakho yokugqibela yahluka ngamihla angu-{days}. Ingcindezi, uhambo, okanye ukugula kunokubangela oku.

information.disclaimer_body: TARA-S yakhiwe phezu kophando olupheleleyo, kwaye sibambe olo phando kwizinga eliphezulu. Kodwa umzimba womfazi ngamnye omhle ngendlela yakhe. Injongo yethu ngokuphi kukupha amava amahle kakhulu nokuhamba nawe kwiziganeko zemvelo zomjikelo wakho.

privacy.title: Esibambileyo, nesizathu.
privacy.subtitle: Esi singowakho. Konke.
privacy.section_collect_body: Iintsuku zakho. Izimpawu zakho. Akunye. Asifuni indawo yakho, abantu oqubisana nabo, okanye imikhwa yakho ngaphandle kwesi sixhobo.
privacy.section_storage_body: Kugcinwe ngokhuselo. Akwabiwa, akathengiswa, akunikwa mntu, nangaliphi na isizathu.
privacy.section_control_body: Thatha konke nawe, okanye susa konke. Uchukumiso olunye ukuze ulande konke. Uchukumiso olunye ukuze ususe konke, ngonaphakade.
privacy.export_error: Kukho into engahambanga kakuhle. Nceda uzame kwakhona.
privacy.delete_confirm: Oku kuya kucima konke ngonaphakade. Akukwazi ukubuyiselwa. Uqinisekile?
privacy.delete_modal_body: Xa sekwenziwe, akukwazi ukubuyiselwa. Yonke iintsuku, zonke izimpawu, konke okwabiwa apha kuya kusuka. Uqinisekile ukuba ufuna ukuliyeka konke?

onboarding.welcome_body: Ngaphambi kokuba siqale, imibuzo embalwa ukufumana umjikelo wakho.
onboarding.date_q1_sub: Oku kusinceda ukufumana ukuba ukuphi kumjikelo wakho namhlanje.
onboarding.date_q2_sub: Iintsuku ezibini zisinceda ukufumana umjikelo wakho.
onboarding.date_q3_sub: Iintsuku ezithathu kwaye sinokuqala ukubona iindlela zakho.
onboarding.ready_sub: TARA-S iya kufunda nawe. Okurekhodayo okuninzi, okuyiqondayo okuninzi.

inactivity.title: Usekhona?
inactivity.body_before: Sithatha imfihlo yakho ngobuqotho. Uya kuphuma kwimizuzwana
